gameDescriptionHtml:
This is a 3D ancient style fantasy, multi ending action role-playing game. As the third installment of the Ryukyu Hidden series and the Ryukyu Hidden Nine Absolute Reincarnation Chapter, the game is designed with the principle of promoting offense and hesitation to defeat in its combat system.

The story begins many years ago when a crystalline fragment of spirit stone suddenly appeared on the earth. It is rumored that this thing can cure a hundred diseases and regenerate nature. The rulers slaughtered extensively in order to collect more fragments, leading to separatist disputes and rampant monsters. This world seems to have become another hell. The protagonist is a member of a mysterious organization who sets foot on an ancient fortress in search of a divine artifact. They meet a group of cunning enemies and fight against the powerful enemies within the fortress, uncovering the truth behind the world’s curse of decay.

Game Features

  • Game features, integrated themes, fast-paced defense and counterattack battles – The ancient style is mystical and fantastical, with strange thoughts and deeds. The battles progress layer by layer, and the plot twists and turns.
  • Collect various martial arts skills and freely match your own system – In addition to honing their combat skills, players also need to analyze the characteristics and strategic strategies of their skill combinations. The game is designed with three sets of active and passive systems, allowing players to quickly familiarize themselves with and combine these skills to quickly defeat and suppress enemies.
  • Multi branch plot and ending – The game adopts a multi branch plot mode, where the order of defeating each branch will affect the original boss or plot structure, resulting in slightly different changes in the plot and drops. Increasing efforts to explore treasures and adventures can greatly reduce the difficulty of facing enemies. The game has a rich combination of skill strategies, a thrilling storyline, and dozens of different mechanisms of enemies.
